title: Complete rank-six locus and rank-seven gap in the fixed-resolvent space
statement: Over every field, the rank-at-most-seven locus of the 31-dimensional mixed outer block is a five-dimensional linear space with common six-dimensional image; its intersection with the pure high block is four-dimensional. The rank-at-most-seven locus of the fixed-resolvent W is exactly a 17-dimensional linear space with a fixed six-dimensional image. Every nonzero member has rank six, and W has no rank-seven matrix.
limitations: Fixed source normalization and fixed resolvent W only. Ordinary matrix rank, not tensor slice rank. Written unreviewed proof and exact integer certificate; no arbitrary singular degeneration exclusion or improved exponent.

title: Sharp dimension 111 under rank109 critical compression
statement: Over every algebraically closed field, two compression factors of sizes 110-by-112 and 112-by-110 and rank109 each kill at most one direction of the fixed-resolvent W. Thus the compressed space has dimension at least111, and111 is attained. A nonzero kernel requires the three-dimensional left kernel to lie inside the fixed six-dimensional image of the rank-six locus.
limitations: Uses algebraic closedness in a determinant-pencil argument. Does not classify larger total rank losses or arbitrary singular trajectories; no target construction, independent review, formalization or exponent improvement.
